R0252.title: Vehicle Data Interface Abuse
R0252.definition: Connected-vehicle APIs, diagnostic interfaces, or third-party in-vehicle apps are abused to read location and driving data.
R0252.description:
Vehicle data interface abuse occurs when connected vehicle APIs, diagnostic interfaces, in-vehicle apps, or third-party services over-read location, route, driving behavior, or vehicle status. Attackers or partners may use the data beyond authorization.

Vehicle data is strongly tied to identity and behavior. Leakage can enable tracking, profiling, insurance discrimination, or preparation for theft. Defenses need granular consent, purpose limitation, and access auditing.
R0252.influence: Vehicle interface abuse can expose location, driving behavior, and vehicle state, creating privacy, safety, and compliance risk.
